text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Now then, my King.
Let us make our way to the audience chamber.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
No, for you, it would not be an audience,
but an "interview." As you are a king of equal standing.
choice_data_list: No, they're definitely not on the same level.
No, they're definitely not on the same level.

text_block_list.text:
Even putting lineage aside...
I feel like I can't compete at all when it comes to presence and warmth.

Anyway, let's go see them.
The benefactor who guided both myself and Durandal
all the way to this point.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me, Your Highness.
Knight Durandal, requesting permission to enter.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...You haven't changed a bit, it seems.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Good day, Durandal.
Seeing you on the racetrack... you've changed a bit.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you've grown up so splendidly!
It really warms my heart♪

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
This was only possible because of your guidance.
My king also conveys her 'gratitude.'

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Good day, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Hey, thanks for inviting me today

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. To be honest, I'm kind of looking forward
to getting poked by Durendal's 'Holy Sword.'

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I do not run
simply for the sake of joy.
Yes, for I have—"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
There are people who look up to me.
Before the eyes of the crowd, I will deliver a run worthy of them.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Your Highness...?
(WOOOAAAHH!)

The two of them radiate graceful smiles in the paddock.
However...
For an instant, I felt like I saw the overwhelming presence of royalty within Fine Motion. That sheer aura was...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...An unyielding heart.

It seemed her rival, Believe,
had also come to watch the race.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
An unyielding spirit, no matter how tough things get.
It's not just me and Biko-san who have that...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Maybe the one with the strongest
share of that destiny is...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"It might be Fine-san.
...That's what Grandma was saying."

A sense of responsibility befitting royalty, and an inner strength.
Fine Motion seems to possess all of those qualities.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Princess.
Races are, of course, about competing for results,
but today is about more than just winning or losing...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Please look forward to my swordcraft during the journey as well.
I will show you how much I have grown.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yeah, Durandal. Come at me with everything you've got!
Royalty does not waver. That strength might even surpass Believe's 'sustainability'. Still—

Let us put on the greatest run we can muster right now.
—The ball of the princess and the knight begins.
